record.what_it_does: Document parsing, extraction, splitting and classification API for turning PDFs and files into structured data.
record.auth_notes: Static API key sent as Authorization: Bearer. Keys are created in Studio by an org Owner. No OAuth was found, so a multi-user toolkit would have each user paste their own key.
record.access_notes: The Standard plan is free to start with $150 in free usage, then pay-as-you-go. Sign-up goes through Studio. I did not open the sign-up page, so the exact key-creation steps are unconfirmed.
record.api_breadth_notes: About 20 operations. Parse, Extract, Split, Classify, Edit and Pipeline each have sync and async versions. Upload and delete upload. Jobs: get, list, cancel, delete. Configure webhook, and Version.
record.mcp_notes: Hosted at mcp.reducto.ai/mcp (docs.reducto.ai/mcp-server). It takes a Bearer API key. I saw this only in search-result summaries, not on the page itself.
record.blocker_notes: The API is public and self-serve with a free credit. The only caveat is that auth is a user-supplied API key rather than OAuth. The API is a document-processing function, not a CRUD product.

evidence.quote: OpenAPI spec: Available at /openapi.json (Parse, Extract, Split, Classify, Edit, Pipeline, Upload, Jobs endpoints)
Asynchronous requests accept a webhook configuration in the async block: svix or direct
Standard plan is free to start and includes $150 in free usage
